&nbsp;Job Position: Digital Marketing / Social Media Manager

	We are looking for a creative, hands-on and commercially minded Digital Marketer / Social Media Manager to attract new customers, generate quality enquiries and increase sales across our online channels and branches.


What You Will Do


	Develop digital marketing campaigns targeting furniture makers, carpenters, interior designers, contractors, retailers and homeowners.
	Set up, manage and optimise paid campaigns on Facebook and Instagram, and other relevant platforms.
	Create persuasive product adverts, captions, graphics and short videos that demonstrate product features and uses.
	Manage our social media pages and plan a consistent content calendar.
	Use WhatsApp Business and other digital channels to promote products, follow up on enquiries and encourage repeat purchases.
	Work closely with the sales and stock teams to ensure promotions reflect current prices and product availability.
	Track leads through to sales and help improve how online enquiries are handled.
	Test different audiences, content and offers to improve results and control advertising costs.
	Report clearly on advertising spend, qualified enquiries, customer acquisition and sales generated.


What We Are Looking For


	Minimum of an OND in Marketing, Mass Communication, Business Administration or a related field.
	At least 2&ndash;3 years of relevant digital marketing experience.
	Proven hands-on experience with Meta Ads Manager, including campaign setup, audience targeting and optimisation.
	Evidence of generating leads, acquiring customers or increasing sales through digital marketing.
	Strong copywriting and content creation skills, with working knowledge of Canva and basic video editing tools.
	Ability to analyse campaign results and recommend practical improvements.
	Good organisation, initiative and ability to work independently.
	Experience with Google Ads, TikTok Ads, e-commerce or marketing physical products is an advantage.


What Success Looks Like


	Your work will be measured by qualified enquiries, new customers, sales conversions, repeat purchases and return on advertising spend.


Salary


	N150,000 - N200,000 + Performance bonus.


Method of Application&nbsp;
Interested and qualified candidates should send their Applications to: hr.robecklocks@gmail.com using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

Digital Marketing / Social Media Manager Job at Robeck Locks Limited




        
    

        
        Robeck Locks Limited was established in 2001 out of a need to bring stylish locksets to the marketplace at affordable prices without compromising on quality, functionality, and durability. We import and distribute a wide range of quality, fashionable door locksets and accessories to the trade and construction companies.

We have multiple branches in Lagos. Our products include furniture handles, locks, hinges, drawer slides, wardrobe fittings and kitchen accessories.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Digital Marketing / Social Media Manager

Job Location: Amuwo Odofin, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Description
     

        



     (adsbygoogle = window.adsbygoogle || []).push({});
    
    




	We are looking for a creative, hands-on and commercially minded Digital Marketer / Social Media Manager to attract new customers, generate quality enquiries and increase sales across our online channels and branches.


What You Will Do


	Develop digital marketing campaigns targeting furniture makers, carpenters, interior designers, contractors, retailers and homeowners.
	Set up, manage and optimise paid campaigns on Facebook and Instagram, and other relevant platforms.
	Create persuasive product adverts, captions, graphics and short videos that demonstrate product features and uses.
	Manage our social media pages and plan a consistent content calendar.
	Use WhatsApp Business and other digital channels to promote products, follow up on enquiries and encourage repeat purchases.
	Work closely with the sales and stock teams to ensure promotions reflect current prices and product availability.
	Track leads through to sales and help improve how online enquiries are handled.
	Test different audiences, content and offers to improve results and control advertising costs.
	Report clearly on advertising spend, qualified enquiries, customer acquisition and sales generated.


What We Are Looking For


	Minimum of an OND in Marketing, Mass Communication, Business Administration or a related field.
	At least 2–3 years of relevant digital marketing experience.
	Proven hands-on experience with Meta Ads Manager, including campaign setup, audience targeting and optimisation.
	Evidence of generating leads, acquiring customers or increasing sales through digital marketing.
	Strong copywriting and content creation skills, with working knowledge of Canva and basic video editing tools.
	Ability to analyse campaign results and recommend practical improvements.
	Good organisation, initiative and ability to work independently.
	Experience with Google Ads, TikTok Ads, e-commerce or marketing physical products is an advantage.


What Success Looks Like


	Your work will be measured by qualified enquiries, new customers, sales conversions, repeat purchases and return on advertising spend.


Salary


	N150,000 - N200,000 + Performance bonus.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their Applications to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

Note: Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

HR Officer Job at African Fertlizers and Chemicals Limited




        
    

        
        African Fertlizers and Chemicals Limited (AFCL) focuses on sustainability, using eco-friendly processes with minimal environmental impact and no harmful by-products. Known for excellent customer service and quick turnaround times, AFCL is a trusted leader, delivering quality and reliability.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: HR Officer
Job Location: Agbara, Ogun
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary
     

        



     (adsbygoogle = window.adsbygoogle || []).push({});
    
    




	Drive day-to-day HR functions at the manufacturing or plant site, ensuring workforce stability, regulatory compliance, safe labor practices, and smooth communication between the plant floor and management.


Key Responsibilities


	Recruitment & Onboarding: Handle end-to-end hiring for shop-floor, contract, and staff positions, including job postings, interviews, medical checks, and induction
	Time, Attendance & Payroll Inputs: Track daily attendance, shift rosters, overtime records, and leave management, passing verified data to payroll
	Employee & Industrial Relations: Address worker grievances, resolve daily conflicts, manage disciplinary cases, and support union or worker-representative relations
	Statutory & Labor Compliance: Ensure adherence to local labor laws, factory acts, pension and tax obligations (such as Nigerian labor and pension guidelines), and health, safety, and environment (HSE) standards.


Qualifications


	B.Sc in any relevant course
	1-3 years of experience
	Professional certification is an additional advantage.


Salary
N120,000 monthly.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should submit their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject the mail.
